name: desktop-mcp
description: Desktop screen size and screenshots for VS Code agents (Copilot) and any MCP client (Claude Code, Grok, Cursor, ...).

languageModelTools.name: desktopMcp_getScreenSize
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the screen geometry in pixels: the virtual screen bounds (origin may be negative on multi-monitor setups) and the bounds of every display. Call this before captureScreenshot when you need to compute a region.

languageModelTools.name: desktopMcp_captureScreenshot
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Takes a screenshot of the whole screen or of a rectangular region and returns it as an image. Coordinates are pixels relative to the virtual screen origin (top-left of the leftmost/topmost display).

region.description: Rectangle to capture. Omit to capture the whole virtual screen.

display.description: Display index (0-based) as returned by getScreenSize. Ignored when region is set.

savePath.description: Absolute path to also save the image to.

desktopMcp.tools.getScreenSize.description: Expose the getScreenSize / get_screen_size tool. When disabled the tool is hidden from agents and any call returns a "disabled by the user" message.

desktopMcp.tools.captureScreenshot.description: Expose the captureScreenshot / capture_screenshot tool. When disabled the tool is hidden from agents and any call returns a "disabled by the user" message.

desktopMcp.httpServer.description: Start the MCP HTTP server automatically when the extension activates, so MCP clients (Claude Code, Cursor, ...) can connect to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp.

desktopMcp.httpPort.description: Port for the MCP HTTP server. Changing it restarts the server automatically.

desktopMcp.registerMcpServer.description: Also expose the screenshot tools to VS Code as an MCP server, in addition to the built-in language model tools. Useful for agents that only speak MCP.
